especially if they say ‘this is just a joke’—that’s a serious cry for help tbh)
transcript: I regret to inform you that if you are receiving this from a loved one, they have been procrastinating something that is stressing them the fuck out, and I am here on their behalf to formally request that you take them out to coffee, sit them down, and don't let them get up until they've got that shit sorted. This is not a joke. It is indirect communication because they feel ashamed of themselves for leaving it this long. To reinforce the gravity of the situation, receiving this is tantamount to them coming to you, crawling on their hands and knees, begging for help. Please do not laugh-react to this without also, at the very least, asking if they're serious. They are. Thank you for your time.
